title: Asymmetry Conservation Under A|E Distinction

basis.scope: Normalize the applied 046 slot-occupancy witness into an additive audit candidate for asymmetry under A|E distinction. The basis is documentary and operational, not theorem-level: it records role-asymmetric admissibility, residue, and orientation checks without altering RT_core or asserting universal symmetry, universal occupancy, or recovery.

core_rule.statement: A|E distinction does not conserve slot symmetry; it preserves distinguishability through role-asymmetric admissibility, residue, or orientation. Completed RT occupants may be compared only after explicit role typing and domain rebinding in the receiving window, and RT_core remains unchanged.

core_claim.statement: A|E distinction does not conserve symmetry. It conserves distinguishability through asymmetry.

principle.statement: For any A|E window, A-slot and E-slot occupancy are not presumed symmetric because distinction itself requires non-identity, directional residue, or role-asymmetric admissibility.

forbidden_inference: slot occupancy does not imply role symmetry
formal_schema.required_condition: Any swap of A/E occupants must be separately checked for admissibility.

interpretation.symmetry: may exist as substrate, reference condition, or prior undifferentiated state
interpretation.distinction: appears only when asymmetry is expressed across the A|E window
interpretation.residue: records or carries the asymmetry/history of the distinction
interpretation.identity: may persist through rebinding, but not by conserving symmetry

relationship_to_patch_046.046_result: Completed RTs may be candidate occupants only after explicit domain rebinding.
relationship_to_patch_046.047_extension: Once rebound into A/E roles, their occupancy is distinction-bearing and therefore not symmetry-conserving by default.

required_repo_changes.change: Add a provenance note identifying PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_046 and its operational witness as the source basis for the asymmetry audit, without promoting the candidate to theorem status.
Record the eventual governed application of PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_047 only if the patch gate returns apply and promotion is authorized.

non_claims: Does not deny that symmetric substrates may exist.
Does not deny that local symmetries may occur inside a completed RT.
Does not assert universal role impossibility under swap.
Does not prove metric measurability yet.

required_followup.task: Test whether A/E swap changes admissibility in the worked Patch 046 example.
Define which quantities are conserved under rebinding: identity, closure, residue, orientation, basin signature.
Clarify whether asymmetry is carried by residue r, role typing, orientation, or all three.
